department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering and Computer Science

deadline.value: Fall admission deadline for the Ph.D. in Engineering is March 1, 2027 (matching the March 1 Graduate Assistantship and Tuition-waiver deadline).
deadline.quote: Fall Admission: March 1 | Ph.D. in Engineering

also.quote: The deadline for submitting applications is March 1.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Electrical or Computer Engineering; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The ECECS and Engineering PhD catalog pages do not state whether a faculty supervisor must agree prior to admission.

funding.value: Division of Graduate Studies Graduate Assistantships (monthly stipend plus tuition for Fall and Spring) and partial/full Graduate Tuition-waivers are awarded competitively via separate application to the department chair or academic dean by March 1.
funding.quote: The Division of Graduate Studies awards assistantships each year with a monthly stipend plus tuition for one academic year: Fall and Spring... The deadline for submitting applications is March 1.

entry_route.value: Requires a B.S. or M.S. in a related engineering field with a 3.0 undergraduate GPA and 3.50 graduate GPA; exceptional B.S.-only engineering applicants (3.5+ GPA) are considered in special cases (72 credits beyond B.S. or 36 beyond M.S.).
entry_route.quote: Minimum undergraduate grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale and minimum graduate GPA of 3.50 on a 4.0 scale are required. In special cases, exceptional applicants with B.S. degrees in engineering will be considered. These applicants must have a minimum GPA of 3.5.

notes: ECECS emphasis areas under the Ph.D. in Engineering: Computer Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Computational Engineering.
